title: Tool Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Porter-Cable 20V Max tools blink one fuel-gauge LED when motor or driver thermal limit reached.

title: Stall Protection
fullDescription: Two blinks signal the motor controller cut current due to stall.

title: Low Battery Cutoff
fullDescription: Three blinks signal the 20V Max pack reached low-voltage cutoff.

title: Charger Defective Pack
fullDescription: Solid red on PCC692L charger means BMS lockout or cell failure.

title: Charger Temperature Hold
shortDescription: Pack out of charging temperature window.
fullDescription: Red blink on PCC692L means pack outside 0-45 C window. Charger waits.

title: Tool Will Not Power On
fullDescription: Dead tool with good pack typically means damaged terminal block or controller failure.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Look in tool foot for bent terminals.

title: Electric Brake Worn
fullDescription: Porter-Cable circular saws use electronic brake; blade should stop within 2 seconds. Slow stop indicates worn motor or controller fault.

fixSteps.title: Replace brushes
fixSteps.instruction: Open brush caps, install fresh brushes.

title: Router Speed Control Erratic
fullDescription: Porter-Cable 690/890 routers use a speed dial that contaminates with sawdust, causing erratic speed.

fixSteps.title: Clean speed dial
fixSteps.instruction: Open housing, blow out and rotate dial through full range.

title: Impact Driver Spins But Won't Hammer
fullDescription: Worn anvil, broken hammer pin, or broken hammer spring stops impact mechanism.

title: Trigger Stuck or Erratic
fullDescription: Sawdust packs trigger preventing return spring; tool may run uncontrolled or refuse to run.
